resume: Stage 3 complete on a repaired pack and ready to re-enter stage 4: spawn the leak reader and the determinism judge together. The stage 4 reader's recorded-series finding was fatal and is fixed in the generator, so the earlier APPROVE is void and nothing of it is relied on. What changed: every FREQ-DEV recording is now bounded by the site's own disturbance recorder (its own deviation threshold, pre-event window, hysteresis, confirmation, arming latency, hold-off and the archive writer's flush and wrap) watching the frequency its own transducer measures, not by the operator's published extract; the per-episode realised gain now scatters on the unit's own frequency measurement error and its controller's gain trim; the 32 degenerate minute-summary rows now carry the mean alone with the minimum and maximum columns empty; and the traverse fit, in the generator and the verifier, now runs at the boundaries the site held no reserve commitment at, which is the criterion the write-up states. Every graded figure moved and the decision did not: KPV 72 (72.11), RDL 83 (82.86), gap 11, three sites below the 90 per cent tolerance, NWV 90.94 above it, rung 0 Zwartewater, rung 1 Reiderland, rung 2 Zwartewater. The determination memo no longer prints a rung 0 figure (no Zwartewater gain can put both that figure and its traverse figure clear of a rounding edge), and step 2 of the write-up now states the 911 site-episode pairs the archive carries a recording of the extreme second for rather than calling them obliged pairs. The judge's two recorded soft spots still stand: 'boundaries at which the site held no reserve commitment' is now the criterion both the generator and the verifier use, and the span recovers exactly with its runner-up one second away at all nine sites.

leak.reader: Owed again on the repaired pack. Pass 3 landed the call at KPV 72, RDL 83, gap 11 and then reported the recorded-series realism defect that this repair answers: the archive's deviation recordings were bounded by the operator's published extract, two sites held identical bound sets, per-site durations ran at sd 11.5 to 18.5 s, the per-episode gain barely varied, and 32 minute-summary rows read minimum, mean and maximum alike with six of them contradicting the extract. All five are fixed in the generator and measured on the cut pack (see the design note's last block). The reader also reported the 512-of-515 concentration of the qualifying episodes' extreme second 67 to 90 s after a period start, which is load-bearing physics and is left as designed; that is the one open question for the next reader, and the physics argument is in the design note.
